authority: Non-authoritative P1 validator vocabulary; descriptive only

rules.source: Morphology v9.4 §7.6.1 R01-AC02; P1.1 predicate_registry (no built-in signatures)
rules.implementation: pinned profile file (SHA-256 in code and SHA256SUMS.txt); unknown profile, local redefinition (D-2) and library_ref SHA mismatch (D-3) are config errors
imported contracts take the context scope_ref; import without scope_ref is a config error; plan scope must equal scope_ref
one current first, one target last, unique ids, contiguous holds_in; order is declared sequence, no dates compared
declared referents and phases; retire/introduce at most once, introduce before retire; T role scheduling and witness pointer present (T value uninterpreted)
dependency subject/object concept IDs checked against exactly one scoped imported or local contract; required qualifiers cannot be met by a dependency
object retired at p and dependency holds in p or later; subject retirement is not checked in v1
object introduced at p and dependency holds before p; subject introduction is not checked in v1
dependency ending at the retiring phase needs successor_ref or dropped; successor shares subject and predicate, starts at the retiring phase, object present in every phase
every rel("supersedes", Y, X) with reference operands must match a transition retiring X and introducing Y; other predicates are not compared with the plan
canonical_admission, current_authority, epistemic_warrant stay NOT_EVALUATED; a PASS plan is a consistent declaration, not a safe or executed migration
